skill.name: elite-mvp-master
skill.description: Guides production-ready OC Pipeline development using React, Node.js, Supabase, and Vercel, with security, error handling, and maintainability requirements.
skill.summary: Build complete OC Pipeline features with strict implementation, error handling, documentation, and plain-language delivery standards.
skill.author: ALPA-Const

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code, network operations, credential access, or external command instructions. No static or semantic security findings were identified.

content.value_statement: Incomplete code and unclear instructions make construction software changes difficult to implement safely. This skill requests complete solutions with error handling and exact steps.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to produce complete files instead of partial snippets or placeholders.
Applies security, scalability, maintainability, edge-case, and error-handling requirements to implementation work.
Targets React, Node.js, Supabase, and Vercel development for the OC Pipeline platform.
Formats delivery as a task summary, complete implementation, and numbered implementation steps.
Adapts instructions for users without software development experience by minimizing jargon and specifying exact actions.
limitations: Provides development guidance only and does not independently deploy, test, or certify software.
Does not include project files, architecture details, database schemas, credentials, or deployment configuration.
References NIST 800-171 and SOC 2 but does not provide compliance controls or audit evidence.
Its OC Pipeline context may require adaptation for unrelated products or technology stacks.

use_cases.title: Implement a Requested Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a plain-language feature request into complete code and exact implementation steps for OC Pipeline.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Production Bug
use_cases.description: Diagnose a reported defect and produce a complete fix with error handling and verification steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Secure Release
use_cases.description: Review planned changes for security, scalability, maintainability, and relevant federal contractor requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Basic Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Build [feature] for OC Pipeline using [stack]. Provide complete changed files and numbered implementation steps in plain language.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a small feature with clear implementation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Reproducible Bug
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix [bug] in [file or component]. Address this reproduction: [steps]. Include complete files, error handling, and verification actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A maintainer has a repeatable defect and relevant project context.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate a Platform Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Integrate [service] with [existing feature]. Cover authentication, validation, failure states, database changes, and deployment steps using complete files.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs coordinated frontend, backend, and platform changes.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [release scope] for security, scalability, maintainability, and compliance gaps. Correct all issues and provide complete files with verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced team needs a comprehensive release review and implementation.

output_examples.input: Add a project status filter to a React page backed by Supabase.
output_examples.output: States the requested change, provides complete React and Supabase file updates, then lists exact implementation and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Review an API route before a federal contractor release.
output_examples.output: Returns corrected route files with validation and error handling, followed by numbered deployment and verification actions.

best_practices: Provide the relevant files, stack details, expected behavior, and acceptance criteria with each request.
Run generated changes in a nonproduction environment and verify every stated edge case.
Use qualified security and compliance reviewers for formal NIST 800-171 or SOC 2 decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not request production-ready output without sharing project constraints and existing architecture.
Do not treat references to federal standards as proof of compliance or certification.
Do not deploy generated changes without code review, testing, and environment-specific validation.

faq.question: Which technology stack does this skill support?
faq.answer: It focuses on React, Node.js, Supabase, and Vercel within the OC Pipeline context.

faq.question: Does this skill write complete files?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to provide complete working files without placeholders.

faq.question: Can nontechnical users use it?
faq.answer: Yes. It requests numbered actions, exact inputs, and minimal technical jargon.

faq.question: Does it guarantee NIST 800-171 or SOC 2 compliance?
faq.answer: No. It highlights compliance context but cannot replace formal controls, evidence, testing, or professional review.

faq.question: Can it deploy changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains guidance only and does not include deployment scripts or credentials.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide relevant files, desired behavior, errors, stack details, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
